test_results_detail.console_errors: Only pre-existing CSP warnings for external scripts (emergent-main.js, posthog, cloudflare beacon). NO i18next missing-key warnings. NO React error overlays.

critical_code_review_comments: Minor: en.json stores CRM extension keys as flat dotted top-level keys ("crm.forecast", "crm.reports", "crm.permissions", "crm.territories", "crm.contracts", "crm.activity_feed", "crm.calendar") while fr.json and de.json nest the same fields under the existing crm object. Both work with i18next default keySeparator, but consolidating to nested form in en.json would prevent future fallback surprises if keySeparator config ever changes.
test_credentials: owner@apexfitness.group / ApexDemo2026! (used for login flow in FR, lands on /dashboard).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Marketing nav testids are slug-based (gx-nav-operations/crm/memberships/marketing/engineers/pricing) and stable across languages. Marketing language selector = native <select data-testid='gx-nav-lang'> (mobile drawer mirror = gx-nav-mobile-lang). /pulse uses a button data-testid='pulse-lang-toggle' that opens a menu with English/Français/Deutsch text items. Default language detection: localStorage.i18nextLng first, then navigator. Use page.evaluate('() => localStorage.setItem("i18nextLng","en")') before navigating to /pulse-pricing or /login (those routes don't expose a language switcher of their own — they inherit the persisted choice). Verified: switching back to English on /pulse fully restores original copy. EN regression intact (Smarter Fitness. Stronger Business.). 254 pulse keys + 136 mkt keys present in both fr.json and de.json. CRM extension keys (forecast/reports/tenders/territories/permissions) all present and correctly translated in both fr.json and de.json.
